purpose: Read-only evidence map for I01 account binding, entitlement, estimates and billing reconciliation.

environment.scope: Local SDK/source inspection only. No secrets read, provider request, quote, network call, SDK upgrade or code change. Only this report is written.

source_evidence.proves: apiKey selects ApiKey auth and the SDK auto-installs that key; API docs say API keys support socket jobs and most REST calls including balance/profile. appId is a stable installation/connection ID unique among simultaneous connections for the same account; second same-ID connection replaces the first. appSource and connection attribution are client-supplied labels.
source_evidence.does_not_prove: The API key string exists/was installed is not an authenticated account identity or validation. appId/appSource are not account IDs. SDK source has no API credential ID/fingerprint or key-rotation event.

source_evidence.proves: Provider-authenticated socket event supplies address and username; account.me() calls `/v1/account/me` and returns server MeData including `walletAddress`, updating the same current-account fields. This wallet address, namespaced by provider, is the strongest stable account identifier visible in SDK source. `isAuthenicated` means walletAddress exists; it differs from ApiKeyAuthManager.isAuthenticated.
source_evidence.does_not_prove: username/email/display names or appId are stable spending identities. ApiKeyAuthManager.isAuthenticated only checks a local key string is set; it does not prove successful server authentication. SDK exposes no credential-to-wallet immutable binding ID or raw-key-free credential version.

source_evidence.proves: API key is sent as `api-key` on REST/socket. Current factory captures `SOGNI_API_KEY`, stable per-role appId and appSource, then caches one clientPromise; web/worker/probe roles use distinct app IDs, worker also locks ownership.
source_evidence.does_not_prove: Presence, role appId and configured env value are not an account evidence record. Cached client means changed env credentials do not rebind an existing client until it is closed/recreated. SDK `backup()` can return raw key and must not be used for evidence/logging.

source_evidence.proves: `/v1/subscriptions/status` yields server-level active/status/tier/period/capabilities/fairUse facts; docs say `active` is authoritative (grace is inactive). `/v1/subscriptions/usage` reports billing-cycle render Spark/jobs and trial counters. `isUnlimited` is only account tier active-state convenience.
source_evidence.does_not_prove: These snapshots do not bind eligibility to a requested Sogni model, settings, quote, or job; fairUse/usage are aggregate, not per-job price. Public plan prices are display-only; feature capabilities are generic booleans, no catalog model coverage relation. Snapshot freshness/version and connection/account binding must be recorded by caller.

source_evidence.proves: A create request may explicitly choose billingMode `subscription` (require Unlimited coverage) or `tokens` (opt out); tokenType is `spark|sogni`, and omitted tokenType defaults to Sogni token. Typed errors distinguish NOT_ENTITLED (4078), queue cap (4079), grace retry (4080), and feature-plan gate (4081).
source_evidence.does_not_prove: No read-only per-model entitlement preflight is exposed. A generic socket error, timeout or these type declarations alone do not prove nonacceptance/refund. Account-level active subscription is not model-specific entitlement. Current adapter sends billingMode but not tokenType (`lib/providers/production/sogni-provider.ts:89-98`), so `tokens` currently defaults to Sogni; I01 must not call this Spark without an explicit token selection.

source_evidence.proves: Server quote endpoints accept request-relevant fields. Image estimate includes model, network, image/step/preview counts, geometry/size, control/reference count, sampler/guidance, quality/output format. Video estimate includes model, tokenType, width/height, duration or frames, fps, steps/media count, image/video reference counts and video-reference duration. Audio includes tokenType/model/duration/steps/media count. Returned decimal strings are `token`, `usd`, `spark`, `sogni`; SDK docs label USD and Spark points. Exact parameters must be passed from immutable snapshot, not browser projection.
source_evidence.does_not_prove: These are estimates, not reservation, entitlement, or guaranteed upper bound. Response has no quote ID, echoed request fingerprint, validity expiry or min/max interval; separate local expiry/revalidation is needed. H3 audio reference pricing is not represented in VideoEstimateRequest. SDK docs specify no decimal scale for Spark/SOGNI fields; do not assume conversion or mix units.

source_evidence.methods: projects.get(projectId) -> RawProject; account.transactionHistory({status:'completed', address, limit, offset?, provider?})
source_evidence.proves: Completed project has server-returned model id, `costEstimate`, `costActual`, project txId, and completed/worker jobs; CostActual string fields are render seconds, USD and token. Transaction-history records expose stable entry id, address, completed status, role, numeric amount, project source/sourceSID, debit type, tokenType, billingMode/paymentModel/tier/trial/throttled facts. Match exact wallet + project sourceSID + project id + transaction id for corroborated debit evidence.
source_evidence.does_not_prove: RawProject costActual is not itself a separately confirmed settlement/refund. Transaction `amount` is a JS number (possible decimal precision loss), history API is filtered to completed entries and has no typed nonacceptance/refund facts. `paymentModel` is open string; absent/ambiguous fields must remain unresolved. No SDK refund lookup or refund event evidence found.

source_evidence.proves: Production `SogniSdkClient` type currently exposes only Projects methods (not Account). `createSogniProductionProvider.quote()` always returns unknownProductionQuote. Quote handler checks persisted project, invokes factory, validates request echo/hash/expiry and persists quote. create factory takes role-only options; it does not accept user-supplied account IDs.
source_evidence.does_not_prove: Current adapter can provide neither stable account evidence, current subscription/balance, model-specific eligibility, nor price/reconciliation. Current Sogni quotes intentionally stay entitlement/amount/cap unknown; this is correct fail-closed behavior.

source_evidence.proves: I01 requires account evidence bound to provider account/credential/connection; explicit currency/unit; exact fresh quote binding; durable reservations; actual/nonacceptance/refund evidence from trusted producer; unknown facts retain liability; no token/USD mixing or assumed zero.
source_evidence.does_not_prove: SDK 5.49 supplies every required producer; current provider adapter lacks these methods, so separate narrow producer/composition ownership needs assignment after domain/contract work.

fail_closed_guidance.account: Use server-returned account.me().walletAddress or authenticated socket address, validate and canonicalize, namespaced by provider. Require connected/authenticated client plus successful identity read. Never trust supplied account id, display name, appId, env-key presence, or a balance alone. Pin a non-secret credential version/fingerprint and role appId; SDK exposes no credential ID, so local HMAC/OS-keychain keyed binding or explicit credential generation is needed. Rotate/invalidate pending quotes on credential/account mismatch.
fail_closed_guidance.entitlement: Account getSubscriptionStatus active/tier is supporting account evidence only. Querying estimate cannot prove coverage. Current public API has no documented read-only per-model check; keep entitlement unknown unless a trusted request-bound provider result proves it. Never interpret `billingMode:'tokens'` as Spark: tokenType is separate and defaults Sogni.
fail_closed_guidance.money: Prefer a declared USD-cent budget only if exact USD decimal estimate is available. Parse decimal strings without JS Number; reject exponent/negative/malformed values and overflow; round a positive USD estimate up to cents (never nearest/down). Point estimate is not a provider-guaranteed upper bound; do not relabel point as guaranteed max. Spark/SOGNI strings have no scale contract here, and transaction history amount is number: do not convert/mix without authoritative scale/precision contract. Missing actual retains original upper estimate liability.
fail_closed_guidance.settlement: Candidate actual debit evidence is completed transaction-history entry matched to wallet/project ID and transaction id; store provider native unit/paymentModel and source/time. RawProject costActual is corroborating reported cost, not standalone proof of ledger settlement. Explicit accepted server pre-admission rejection could be a nonacceptance producer only after proving its API semantics and matching request/reference; generic socket errors/timeouts/cancel/media completion never release. SDK exposes no typed refund/nonacceptance reconciliation facts: keep reservation unresolved or require separate authenticated/manual append-only evidence per I01.

smallest_seams_for_assignment.provider_adapter: Later bounded provider task: extend typed SDK transport narrowly with authenticated `readAccountEvidence`, `getSubscriptionStatus`, balance refresh, request-shaped `estimate`, and reconciliation lookup. Return normalized provider/account/unit fields with observedAt/evidence source. Do not expose raw credentials. Keep live model catalog separate from billing evidence.
smallest_seams_for_assignment.composition: Separate integrator-owned factory/quote-route work must bind adapter evidence to server-owned account scope and canonical request hash; after C04, current handler only checks project and provider quote response. Do not place provider-specific wallet/credential fields in browser command.
smallest_seams_for_assignment.domain: I01 B1 can define account/provider evidence, typed budget units, quote companion binding, reservations and trusted reconciliation ports. Keep provider-specific account identity and transaction parsers outside the neutral I01 domain; inject versioned evidence through ports. Expand scope only by integrator assignment.

research_limits: No web sources used: package source/type contract was locally installed at 5.49.0 and task explicitly requested source research.
No runtime integration calls were executed; method observations are source/type evidence only.
C04/I01 remain unaccepted until assigned provider composition and I01 implementation/review complete.
